title: Just Juice Exotic Fruits Strawberry & Curuba Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Also known as Banana Passionfruit, Curuba is a South American fruit that adds a distinctly tangy and refreshing tropical note to this delicious e-liquid, improved further with the flavour of fresh, succulent strawberries. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
